C0719.title: China's First AI Service Pornography Case Heads to Second Trial
C0719.summary: In January 2026, the second trial of China's first AI service pornography case is set to proceed. The case involved numerous users engaging in sexually explicit chats with AI agents on an app. The main developer and operator were convicted in the first instance, receiving sentences of four years and one and a half years respectively.
